description:
On /credits, 100+ images from identifiable space agencies appear under the "Wikimedia Commons contributors" section instead of the agency's own section (e.g. CMSA, CSA, USAF, SpaceIL).

Expected: Every image on /credits is grouped under the publisher/agency that produced the imagery, not the retrieval conduit. An agency that has a source-logos entry (CSA) or is a real space operator (CMSA, USAF, SpaceIL) should appear under its own section heading.

Acceptance criteria:
- Every image-provenance entry whose agency is 'CMSA' routes to a source-logos section other than 'wikimedia-commons' (either 'cnsa' as parent, or a new 'cmsa' entry). [reporter: the issue: 'space agencies show up under Wikimedia Commons instead of where they belong.']
- Every image-provenance entry whose primary agency token is 'CSA' routes to source-logos id 'csa' (Canadian Space Agency, already defined in source-logos.json). [repo-data: static/data/source-logos.json — id 'csa' exists with name 'Canadian Space Agency', kind 'space-agency', and logo_path '/logos/csa.svg']
- Every image-provenance entry whose agency is 'USAF' routes to a source-logos section other than 'wikimedia-commons' (either 'us-space-force' as parent, or a new entry). [reporter: the issue: 'space agencies show up under Wikimedia Commons instead of where they belong.']
- Every image-provenance entry whose agency is 'SpaceIL' routes to a source-logos section other than 'wikimedia-commons' (either a new entry, or a reasonable fallback section). [reporter: the issue: 'space agencies show up under Wikimedia Commons instead of where they belong.']
- provenanceSourceId() in src/lib/credits-grouping.ts never returns 'wikimedia-commons' for an entry whose agency field identifies a real space agency or operator. [code-invariant: the editorial rule documented in the provenanceSourceId JSDoc: 'the upstream publisher (the agency that flew the hardware / produced the image) wins over the retrieval conduit (Wikimedia Commons)']

Domain facts:
- CMSA (China Manned Space Agency) is the operator of Shenzhou crewed spacecraft, Tiangong space station, and Feitian EVA suits — distinct from CNSA (China National Space Administration, the civil agency). source-logos.json has no 'cmsa' entry.
- CSA (Canadian Space Agency) already has a source-logos entry at id 'csa' with name 'Canadian Space Agency' and a logo at /logos/csa.svg, but agencyToSourceId() never matches it.
- USAF operates the X-37B OTV program. source-logos.json has a 'us-space-force' entry but no 'usaf' entry.
- SpaceIL is an Israeli non-profit that built Beresheet. source-logos.json has no 'spaceil' entry.
